title_lines: 股价重挫 信用市场定价违约概率上升
CEO称市场理性 仍看好业务模式

subtitles.en: Now Core Weave shares also plunged 15% as its bonds hit levels that typically indicate distress.
subtitles.zh: CoreWeave股价也大跌15%，其债券收益率触及通常预示压力的水平。

subtitles.en: Critic default swaps are pricing in a more than 50% chance of default within the next five years.
subtitles.zh: 信用违约互换市场定价显示，未来五年内违约概率超过50%。

subtitles.en: But CEO Mike Intrata says the market is acting rationally and he remains confident in the company's business model. Let's get to San Francisco now for more with our ticket to Nick Turner.
subtitles.zh: 但CEO Mike Intrator表示市场反应理性，他仍对公司商业模式充满信心。现在连线旧金山的Nick Turner了解更多。
en_highlights: confident in the company's business model

subtitles.en: So Nick, something to see here or nothing to see here as the Core Weave CEO says.
subtitles.zh: Nick，CoreWeave CEO说的情况，是有实质问题还是没什么可担心的？

subtitles.en: I'm sure it's something in between those two extremes, but this is a company that's obviously been a very successful one of the biggest IPOs last year with a promise of building out the AI
subtitles.zh: 我相信情况介于两个极端之间，但这家公司显然是去年最成功的IPO之一，承诺要建设AI基础设施。

subtitles.en: infrastructure. It's a category of companies we call Neo Clouds and it certainly has tremendous
subtitles.zh: 这类公司我们称之为新云，它确实拥有巨大的

subtitles.en: demand that is working with and some huge customers. And the main question here is it's a very expensive business that they're getting into here and whether ultimately the costs are going
subtitles.zh: 需求，与一些大客户合作。主要问题是他们进入的这个业务非常昂贵，最终成本是否会

subtitles.en: to be too great. But as you mentioned, the CEO is confident that the, you know, the company's on track and that it's going to have enough orders to be able to cover its debts.
subtitles.zh: 过高。但如你所说，CEO有信心公司步入正轨，将有足够订单来覆盖债务。

subtitles.en: It's perhaps not the most ideal of my conditions to be preparing for an IPO. We know that's going to happen for anthropic no later than the end of this year. We've got that November sort of date
subtitles.zh: 在目前条件下准备IPO或许并非最理想。我们知道Anthropic最迟今年年底会进行，我们正朝着11月那个日期努力。

subtitles.en: that we're working towards. Were there revenue numbers enough to invest, to impress investors,
subtitles.zh: 营收数字是否足以吸引市场参与者？

大实话角度来自表达者身份与观点反差；言行反差角度必须有公开动作或披露支撑
涉及中国比较优势时，优先把外国企业被迫调整、海外权威改口或中国优势被低估写成冲突
avoid_patterns: 过长的新闻句，尤其是 24 字以上还塞多个从句
只有 策略/机会/影响/前瞻/市场/风险 这类泛词，没有具体对象或张力
美国宏观泛标题如果没有美联储/鲍威尔等强锚点，点击明显弱
纯描述式标题，例如 某市场短期风险与长期催化剂，缺少问题和冲突
经济危机/金融危机/崩盘/崩溃 这类过硬负面财经词
把事实换成疑问号但没有反差，例如 回报路径在哪、未来如何、能否实现

把 Bloomberg LP 等来源或公司法律后缀误当成采访对象
